scope_note: Each of 15 public-AI services (12 scenario cards + 3 industry validation tests) is rehearsed once as qualified and once against each of seven failure branches (missing responsible role, data exceeds declared ceiling, same-task human route unavailable, cannot pause or deactivate, revision not publicly disclosed, bequest dividend missing, post-exit service lapses). 120/120 checks pass only because all 105 negative branches are blocked; any negative branch wrongly released fails the whole rehearsal. Receipts are derived from (service_id, variant, seed) and re-verifiable offline via visual/assets/simulate-check.js.
disclaimer: concept-only：本登记为方案运行机制的推演（tabletop simulation），不代表任何服务已在实施、已获批或已进入实际测试。
summary_zh: 智脉脉冲协议推演登记：15 项公共 AI 服务（12 张场景卡 + 3 个产业测试场景）逐项核对 P1-P4 四拍与五类回滚触发器，全部通过 P1 申报五要素核验。

P1.failure_zh: 任一要素缺失不进入测试

requirements_zh: 受控试点（预约、分区、现场安全员、实体急停、独立复测）
P2.failure_zh: 未完成复测不进入发布

requirements_zh: 公开运行；导视状态灯可视化（稳定波形/脉冲闪烁/平线）
P3.failure_zh: 运行边界失效即降级回P2
P3.failure_en: boundary breach degrades back to P2

requirements_zh: 数据回检、公众反馈与失败记录公开

rollback_triggers.safety: 安全类：实体或线上安全事件，事故即停
rollback_triggers.privacy: 隐私类：数据越界或投诉成立
rollback_triggers.heritage: 文保类：与文物风貌冲突即撤除
rollback_triggers.ecology: 生态类：扰民、噪声或公共空间占用争议
rollback_triggers.economics: 经济类：运营不可持续且无替代资金来源
